prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to showcase the companion certificate prominently.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Confirm your desktop companion's details to complete the adoption process."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Home Waiting Estimate & Notification: Display an estimated waiting timer and enable desktop notifications while the pet is initializing.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We are bringing your pet to life! You will be notified as soon as it arrives on your desktop."}}
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Data Protection Hint: Add a prominent explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in preserves pet customization across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your desktop pet securely to your account so you never lose your companion or progress."}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Controls Guide Screen: Insert a clear desktop controls introduction screen after completing onboarding to explain pet interaction and visibility controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls_overview"], "new_desktop_controls_overview": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access settings right from your desktop toolbar.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Path Selection Copy: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path screen to clarify choices and reduce hesitation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Pick quick setup to adopt immediately or custom photo setup to create a unique companion."}}
5: [choose_path, reorder] Early Path Selection Reorder: Place the path selection step before the story introduction screen so users immediately pick their setup path on launch.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Guidelines Pre-Upload Screen: Introduce a photo guidelines sub-flow screen right before photo uploads to prevent custom generation errors.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_guidelines", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_guidelines": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Tips for Great Custom Pets", "body": "Upload clear, well-lit front photos for best pet creation results.", "button_label": "Continue to Upload"}}
7: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Notification: Configure desktop notification alerts when home welcome screen displays so users notice pet launch on screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Your Pet Has Arrived!", "body": "Look at your screen! Your new companion is now running on your desktop."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Path Progress Indicator: Show onboarding step progress counter and progress bar during path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_progress": true}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Split Screen Layout: Change sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing account benefits alongside sign-in options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Secure Your Companion Account", "body": "Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync settings across devices."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the certificate layout inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4 as long as the screen functionality remains intact.
Adding an estimated wait time and ready notifications during actual pet creation is allowed under rules 4 and 5.
Adding an explanatory hint to the sign-in screen is valid copy customization within onboarding.
Adding a new controls guide screen after home_intro inside onboarding is explicitly permitted by rule 4.
Clarifying copy on choose_path while maintaining options to adopt or create your own complies with rules 2 and 4.
Reordering onboarding steps is explicitly permitted by rule 4 as long as no step is removed.
Inserting a photo guidelines screen as a sub-flow prior to upload is permitted under rule 4.
Configuring desktop notifications and copy on the home_intro screen is allowed under rule 4.
Adding onboarding progress indicators to the choose_path screen is allowed under rule 4.
Changing the sign-in layout to a split screen with benefit messaging is allowed under rule 4.
